lines.zh: 洞穴鸭轻盈地游动着，发出咕咕声。
lines.en: Talpanas waddles softly, making a low quack.

lines.zh: 它在黑暗中缓缓游动，寻找食物。
lines.en: Talpanas moves slowly in the darkness, seeking food.

lines.zh: 洞穴鸭在洞穴中穿梭，发出轻微的咕咕声。
lines.en: Talpanas flutters through the cave, making a faint quack.

lines.zh: 它在泥土中翻找，寻找美味的苔藓。
lines.en: Talpanas digs through the soil, searching for tasty moss.

lines.zh: 洞穴鸭在洞穴中游动，发出温和的叫声。
lines.en: Talpanas waddles in the cave, making a soft call.

lines.zh: 它在黑暗中游动，寻找新的食物来源。
lines.en: Talpanas moves in the dark, seeking new food sources.

lines.zh: 洞穴鸭在洞穴壁根下翻找食物。
lines.en: Talpanas searches for food beneath the cave roots.

lines.zh: 它在洞穴深处游动，发出咕咕声。
lines.en: Talpanas moves in the deep cave, making a low quack.

lines.zh: 洞穴鸭在洞穴中游动，享受着黑暗。
lines.en: Talpanas waddles in the cave, enjoying the darkness.

lines.zh: 它在洞穴里游动，寻找洞穴垂根。
lines.en: Talpanas moves in the cave, looking for cave roots
It shuffles along the cave wall in small steps.

lines.zh: 它把头探进泥土里翻拱。
lines.en: It roots its head into the soil and digs.
It plants one foot before taking the next.

lines.zh: 它绕开火把照亮的那块地。
lines.en: It skirts the patch your torch lights up.
It hurries back the moment it reaches light.
It pushes aside loose stones for insects.

lines.zh: 影子一晃，它已挪了半圈。
lines.en: One flicker of shadow and it has circled halfway.

lines.zh: 它沿着垂根一路刨过去。
lines.en: It digs its way along a run of hanging roots.

lines.zh: 洞穴鸭静静地站立，眼睛紧闭。
lines.en: Talpanas stands still, closing its eyes.

lines.zh: 它静静地站在原地，享受宁静。
lines.en: Talpanas stands quietly, enjoying the peace.

lines.zh: 洞穴鸭轻盈地站立，偶尔咕咕几声。
lines.en: Talpanas stands lightly, occasionally making a quack.

lines.zh: 它静静地站立，思考食物。
lines.en: Talpanas stands quietly, contemplating food.

lines.zh: 洞穴鸭在洞穴深处闲逛，偶尔低头寻找食物。
lines.en: Talpanas wanders in the deep cave, occasionally lowering its head to find food.

lines.zh: 它安静地站立，沉思着寻找食物。
lines.en: Talpanas stands quietly, pondering food sources.

lines.zh: 洞穴鸭静静地站立，偶尔低头寻找食物。
lines.en: Talpanas stands still, occasionally lowering its head to find food.

lines.zh: 它静静地站立，等待更好的食物机会。
lines.en: Talpanas stands quietly, waiting for better food opportunities.

lines.zh: 洞穴鸭静静地站立，环顾四周。
lines.en: Talpanas stands still, looking around.

lines.zh: 它静静地站立，观察周围环境。
lines.en: Talpanas stands quietly, observing its surroundings.

lines.zh: 它把头藏进翅膀里打盹。
lines.en: It tucks its head under a wing and dozes.
It squats in a dark corner without moving.
It tilts its head to the dripping water.

lines.zh: 洞顶有光透进来，它缩了缩。
lines.en: Light leaks from above, and it shrinks back.

lines.zh: 它把喙在石头上磨了磨。
lines.en: It hones its bill on a stone.

lines.zh: 一小块苔藓被它啄个不停。
lines.en: It keeps pecking at a patch of moss.

lines.zh: 它警惕地看着你，发出警惕的叫声。
lines.en: Talpanas looks at you cautiously, making an alert call.

lines.zh: 洞穴鸭紧张地盯着你，发出轻微的叫声。
lines.en: Talpanas fixes you with a tense gaze, making a faint call.

lines.zh: 它凝视着你，发出轻微的叫声。
lines.en: Talpanas stares at you, making a soft call.

lines.zh: 洞穴鸭警惕地盯着你，似乎在寻找逃脱路线。
lines.en: Talpanas watches you cautiously, as if searching for an escape route.

lines.zh: 它小心地观察你，发出轻微的叫声。
lines.en: Talpanas carefully observes you, making a soft call.

lines.zh: 洞穴鸭紧张地看着你，似乎害怕被发现。
lines.en: Talpanas looks at you anxiously, seeming afraid of being discovered.

lines.zh: 它紧张地盯着你，发出警惕的叫声。
lines.en: Talpanas fixes you with a tense gaze, making an alert call.

lines.zh: 洞穴鸭警惕地盯着你，似乎在寻找逃跑机会。
lines.en: Talpanas watches you cautiously, searching for an escape opportunity.

lines.zh: 它紧张地盯着你，发出轻微的叫声。
lines.en: Talpanas stares at you anxiously, making a faint call.

lines.zh: 洞穴鸭警惕地盯着你，准备逃跑。
lines.en: Talpanas watches you cautiously, ready to flee.

lines.zh: 它从垂根后探出半个头。
lines.en: It pokes half a head out from the hanging roots.
You look, and it retreats into the dark.
It hurts!
This hurts a lot.
My wings are hurt!
Help! I'm hurt!
I'm shivering.
That hurts.
My feet are hurt!
The light is too bright; my eyes hurt.
I need help!

lines.zh: 我的蹼被蹭破了，走不稳。
lines.en: My webbing is scraped open; I can't walk steady.

lines.zh: 你手中的光太亮了，我好害怕！
lines.en: The light in your hand is too bright; I’m scared!
Quick, give me something to eat!

lines.zh: 那些石头下面有什么好吃的？
lines.en: What tasty snacks are under those stones?
Don’t move; I can’t find anything to eat!

lines.zh: 嘿，这里的泥土里有虫子！
lines.en: Hey, there are worms in the soil here!

lines.zh: 你别吓我，我会给你挖垂根的！
lines.en: Don’t scare me; I’ll give you some roots!

lines.zh: 这里的食物太少了，我要去找点！
lines.en: There’s not enough food here; I’m going to find more!

lines.zh: 求求你，别把我的家弄乱！
lines.en: Please don’t mess up my home!

lines.zh: 这里的食物很丰富，我来定居吧！
lines.en: There’s plenty of food here; I’ll settle down!

lines.zh: 快来帮我找食物，我好饿！
lines.en: Come help me find food; I’m starving!

lines.zh: 把火把拿远一点，我就来。
lines.en: Move the torch away and I will come.
Are you holding insects in your palm?

lines.zh: 这块泥松，下面一定有好东西。
lines.en: This soil is loose. Something good is under it.
I do not eat bright things, only damp ones.
You dig first. I will watch from here.
Push the dirt aside and I will pick for myself.
Watch out, I bumped into you!
Don’t touch me; I’m scared!
I hit the cave wall; that hurts!
Don’t push me; I’ll fall!

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，我要躲起来！
lines.en: You bumped into me; I’m going to hide!
Watch out, I hit the cave ceiling!
Don’t move; I hit you!
You hit my wings; that hurts!
I hit the cave floor; I’m safe!
Don’t move; I hit your leg!
Find a spot, I’m going to lay eggs!
Please don’t scare my eggs!
I’m looking for a mate, someone who understands!
Come incubate my eggs with me!

lines.zh: 我要找个安静的地方交配！
lines.en: I need a quiet place to mate!
Please don’t scare my mate!

lines.zh: 快来交配，我的卵需要精子！
lines.en: Come mate, my eggs need sperm!

lines.zh: 找个地方，我要和你交配！
lines.en: Find a spot, I want to mate with you!

lines.zh: 快来交配，我的卵快不行了！
lines.en: Come mate, my eggs are almost gone!

lines.zh: 找个安全的地方，我要交配！
lines.en: Find a safe spot, I’m going to mate!

lines.zh: 轻轻拍拍它，它会乖乖趴你头上。
lines.en: Pat it gently, it'll rest on your head.
Don't worry, it can't fly away.

lines.zh: 它会在泥土中挖洞找吃的。
lines.en: It digs in the soil for food.

lines.zh: 小心，光线太亮会吓到它。
lines.en: Be careful, bright light will scare it.

lines.zh: 把它放在洞穴入口，它会顶在头上。
lines.en: Place it at the cave entrance, it'll sit on your head.
It feeds in the dark.
Use its roots to decorate your home.
It hunts at night.
It digs for bugs in the soil.

lines.zh: 它的垂根很特别，拿来装饰吧。
lines.en: Its roots are special, use them for decoration.

lines.zh: 它会从黑暗中慢慢靠近你。
lines.en: It slowly approaches from the darkness.

lines.zh: 光线太亮时，它会躲起来。
lines.en: It hides when it's too bright.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处，你常常发现它。
lines.en: It's often found deep in the caves.

lines.zh: 它对洞穴的每一个角落都很熟悉。
lines.en: It knows every corner of the caves.

lines.zh: 黑暗里的叫声，是我放的。
lines.en: That cry in the dark is mine.
It avoids bright places.

lines.zh: 在洞穴中寻找它的踪迹。
lines.en: Search for it in the caves.

lines.zh: 它在暗处嗅着岩缝里的虫。
lines.en: It sniffs the cracks for insects in the dark.

lines.zh: 你可能在石头缝隙中找到它。
lines.en: You might find it in stone crevices.

lines.zh: 它的声音很微弱，不易察觉。
lines.en: Its voice is soft and hard to hear.
It gently pecks at you.
Use food to lure it closer.
It tries to get closer to you.
It's scared of heights, it won't fly.
Call softly, it will respond.

lines.zh: 它可能会靠近你寻求保护。
lines.en: It might approach you for protection.
Be careful, it avoids bright light.
Use its roots to attract it.

lines.zh: 它会用叫声告诉你位置。
lines.en: It uses its call to tell you its location.
It tries to get close to you for food.
Quack, put it down!
Plop, can't catch me!
Bang, bang, don't touch me!
Quack, stay away!
Pfft, scare you!
Slap, don't grab me!
Splat, I can't fly!
Quack, let go of me!
Pfft, don't scare me!
Bang, retreat!
Quack, new home!
Quack, darkness is safe!
Splat, another cave!
Quack, it's so quiet here!
Quack, there's food here!
Splat, my new home!
Quack, welcome to the cave!
Quack, found a home in the dark!
Quack, this is safe!
Quack, my new home!

lines.zh: 暗处的泥里钻出一只鸭。
lines.en: A duck waddles out of the dark soil.
A cooing comes from deeper in the cave.
Your torch singed my feathers!
Ouch! I fell!
Help! I'm drowning!
Boom! I'm hurt!

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的胸羽，好深。
lines.en: Something lodged deep in my breast feathers.

lines.zh: 洞里太亮，我又被魔法照了一遍。
lines.en: The cave is too bright, and magic lit it again.
I'm starving to death.
Lightning! It hurts!
Void! It hurts!
